# Vendored third-party assets

Self-hosted, minified third-party bundles. Pinned to known versions so the
dashboard makes no third-party network calls at runtime.

| Bundle | Version | License |
|--------|---------|---------|
| echarts/echarts.min.js | 5.5.1 | Apache-2.0 |
| sortable/Sortable.min.js | 1.15.6 | MIT |

See each subdirectory README for source URLs and upgrade steps.
